page.overview:
Who is Crunch?

Crunch, also known as Tanxx in Germany and Сапер (Saper, "Sapper") in Russian, is an Alpha Team minifigure first introduced in a 2000 video game before making a physical debut in 2001.

In the 5714 LEGO Alpha Team PC game, Crunch wears a black jumpsuit with what appears to be a green overalls or vest worn over it. He has the Alpha Team insignia on the center of his chest, two sticks of dynamite on his vest, and a tool with a circular gauge. His right sleeve is dark green and his gloves are grey. His legs feature multiple tears. He wears a black Mini Headsquare Scarf; although its in-game model is simplified, it is more recognizable as the physical piece in the box art. His face is textured with a lowered brow, a wide mouth, a chin line, stubble, and a headset with a microphone.

When Crunch made his physical debut in 2001, his minifigure design was based upon his video game model with some minor color differences, such as his left shoulder strap being dark green instead of grey.

Crunch's Mission Deep Sea variant retains much of his 2001 minifigure design, with the most notable changes being switching black to earth blue and different leg printing that matches other Alpha Team agents in the subtheme. He wears a dark grey Mini Crash Helmet with a transparent blue Divers Mask and a dark grey Oxygenbottle With Tube, with his black Mini Headsquare Scarf supplied as an alternative hair piece.
